sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a long hall inside a great white temple of the makers, bone-white stone walls banded in ochre, glyph lines running along them like the lines on a wing. Out of a round vent in the far end's mouth a gust of wind blows down the hall, drawn as pale streaming lines of dust and loose feathers; low curved stone screens stand staggered along the floor. A stone ball sits in a groove by the near end, waiting to be pushed up the hall into the vent. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack crouches in the lee of a screen, cloak whipping, waiting out the gust before the run to the next, dwarfed by the hall. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, bone white, ochre bands, aqua sky light, peach light, rose-mauve shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
